title: CI streamline: no duplicate re-runs of already-approved code; triage required checks by what a PR touches; measure before paid resources
note: Operator 2026-11-03 ~21:20Z: cut CI per PR, no checks on already-approved code, triage by importance, then measure. PR runs 11:06Z->21:07Z (100 each): pytest-run 2369 (p50 21.9), guards 1264 (p50 10.0). PR open->merge, 183 PRs merged in 24h to 21:20Z: p50 28.6 / p90 91.8 min (human n=57 p50 47.8 / p90 166.9; data-commit n=46 p50 26.2; research bookkeeping n=58 p50 25.7). PLAN: (1) drop push-to-main triggers of pytest-run/guards/pytest-collect/repo-inventory, scheduled 2h backstops; (2) shallow checkout in pytest-run+guards; (3) change-class map for guards+pytest-run; (4) affected-tests already exists on PRs (pytest_run_scope.py); (5) batch bookkeeping PRs -> next row; (6) update_pull_request_branch on stuck PRs. Item 4 (affected tests) already existed. Item 5 -> row CI-BATCH-BOOKKEEPING.
